an8.50:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] catuhi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo idha lokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, ayaṃsā loko āraddho hoti.
an8.50:1.3: idha bhikkhave mātugāmo susaṃvihitakammanto hoti saṅgahītaparijano, bhattu manāpaṃ carati, sambhataṃ anurakkhati.
an8.50:2.2: idha bhikkhave, mātugāmo ye te bhattu abbhantarā kammantā …pe…
an8.50:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, mātugāmo susaṃvihitakammanto hoti.
an8.50:3.2: idha bhikkhave mātugāmo yo so bhattu abbhantaro antojano …pe…
an8.50:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, mātugāmo saṅgahītaparijano hoti.
an8.50:4.1: katañca bhikkhave, mātugāmo bhattu manāpaṃ carati,
an8.50:4.2: idha bhikkhave, mātugāmo yaṃ bhattu amanāpa saṅkhātaṃ, taṃ jīvitahetupi na ajjhācarati.
an8.50:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, mātugāmo bhattu manāpaṃ carati.
an8.50:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, mātugāmo sambhataṃ anurakkhati.
an8.50:5.4: imehi kho bhikkhave, catuhi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo idha lokavijayāyapaṭipannā hoti, ayaṃsā loko āraddho hoti.
an8.50:6.1: catuhi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo paralokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti. parassāloko āraddho hoti.
an8.50:6.3: idha bhikkhave, mātugāmo saddhāsampanno hoti, sīlasampanno hoti, cāgasampanno hoti, paññāsampanno hoti.
an8.50:7.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave mātugāmo saddhāsampanno hoti.
an8.50:8.2: idha bhikkhave mātugāmo pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā hoti …pe… surāmeraya majjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti …pe…
an8.50:8.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, mātugāmo sīlasampanno hoti.
an8.50:9.2: idha bhikkhave, mātugāmo vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati …pe…
an8.50:9.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, mātugāmo cāgasampanno hoti.
an8.50:10.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, mātugāmo paññāsampanno hoti.
an8.50:10.4: imehi kho bhikkhave, catuhi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo paralokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti. parassa loko āraddho hotīti.
